description: User configuration schema (~/.config/t3-tri-plan/config.json) for t3-tri-plan v1.0.0.

authorizedProviders.description: User config ONLY: providerInstanceIds explicitly authorized by the user to receive repository context. Project .t3-tri-plan.json overrides referencing any provider outside this list require explicit user confirmation before dispatch.

unifiedEffort.description: Required when effortMode is unified: value from the strict intersection of allowed effort options across all designers; applied to every designer.

defaultReviewer.description: Default single reviewer for Phase 3 incremental and confirmation-full rounds. Also inherited by Phase 2a blind judge when top-level judge is omitted.

judge.description: Optional explicit Phase 2a blind judge model. When omitted, inherits config defaultReviewer (never indirectly modified by per-call single= or model= overrides).

unifiedEffort.description: Required when effortMode is unified: value from the strict intersection of allowed effort options across all council reviewers; applied to every member.
